ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Corrected Weight is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Missing Cargo'), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_CorrectedWeight__c ))),
AND( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Weight Discrepancy'),ISPICKVAL( Status ,'New'), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_CorrectedWeight__c ))
) )
